$notes.about: How hits feel (web/src/features/impact-recoil-feature.ts). Buildings push back: every hero hit reports the share of the punch's energy the target soaked up (0 = paper, 1 = stopped dead) and the recoil scales with it.
$notes.speedLoss: extra share of speed lost bursting through at full soak, on top of flight.smashSpeedKept
$notes.stagger: seconds of stagger at full soak (boost cut, weak steering): burst = broke through, dent = bounced off
$notes.staggerSteer: share of steering left during a stagger
$notes.tumble: rad of roll knocked into the hero at full soak (the flight model's bank springs it back)
$notes.deflect: rad/s of pitch and yaw rate knocked into the flight path at full soak, bouncing off only (bursting through, the hero keeps its line through the hole)
$notes.hitStop: seconds of hit-stop for a hero hit: base + perSoak·soak, + topple when the building falls (runs at simulation.hitStop.timeScale)
$notes.cameraPunch: at full soak: jolt = m the camera is knocked along the hit, fov = degrees it punches in; surge = degrees it kicks out when the stagger ends and the hero breaks free
$notes.blast: a heavy landing within radius m rocks the hero: rad of roll = energy / reference J × (1 − d/radius)², capped at max, at most every cooldown s
